name: actually-im-the-ahole
description: An Agent Skill that performs the final-pass discretion review of agent-authored text — markdown, code comments, READMEs, LICENSE files, commit messages, PR descriptions, skill files, generated docs — before that text lands in a tracked repo artifact under the user's byline. Evaluates fourteen risk classes: characterization of user instructions, characterization of user actions or capability, defensive framings dragging the user in, unverified factual claims about third parties, editorializing about user choices, tone mismatch, attributed quotes without confirmation, private-context leakage, mirroring polarizing positions back amplified, self-attribution leakage, coalition-asymmetric balance-injection, sycophancy capitulation under iteration, confident-declarative voice without grounding, and attribution-laundering. Triggers prospectively via Bash(git commit) / Bash(gh pr create) PreToolUse hooks and via the Stop / SubagentStop session-end hook, and retrospectively via explicit /actually-im-the-ahole invocation on a named scope. The skill reports findings with suggested amendments and waits for per-finding user decisions; never amends autonomously. The user is the byline on every commit the agent makes under their name; this skill is the discretion-review the agent runs before that byline carries content the user would not have authored.
